22 Years of Achievement

We're celebrating 22 years as an independent aviation regulatory authority in Guyana.

Read More

GCAA was established in March 2002 as a result of the Civil Aviation Act 2000 being approved by Parliament. The Authority has the responsibility of managing and regulating civil aviation in Guyana, and to ensure that it complies with international standards.
